messages:
maria: 🎉 Huge team update — we just crossed 5,000,000 API requests this month and officially hit $10M ARR 🚀. Cannot believe how fast this is growing, huge thanks to everyone! https://console.redwood.ai/usage :tada:
jamal: OMG congrats!! :tada: :rocket:
priya: Incredible work y'all. Can we do a quick virtual toast tomorrow? 🥂
alex: +1 for a toast. Also shoutout to the infra folks who kept latency sane during the spike :heart:
deploy-bot: deploy v3.12.1 to production succeeded — no rollback needed :white_check_mark:
emily: maria you crushed the outreach plan — marketing numbers look great too. Cake when we return to SF office? 🍰
jorge: Can we get a tiny in-office celebration (balloons, maybe stickers)? happy to organize.
sean: Poll: virtual happy hour Fri 4pm or Mon 6pm? React with :beer: for Fri, :coffee: for Mon.
priya: also, major props to the evals team — regression rate stayed flat despite 3 model rollouts.
kudos-bot: +5 kudos to @maria, +3 kudos to @jamal for incident handling last week.
maria: thank you all — this is a real team win. love the idea of stickers & a tiny cake, jorge. jamal can you share the poll link?
jamal: here — <https://slack-forms.local/poll/5Mparty> :party_parrot:
emily: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebration-teamwork-3o6gbbuLW76jkt8vIc
alex: tiny humble brag: backend p95 latency dropped 8% this sprint. nice work infra.
sean: I grabbed a box of stickers from the merch closet — will drop in meeting room A at 3pm tomorrow.
priya: RSVP for virtual happy hour +1
maria: ok plan = stickers + cake in SF office 3pm tomorrow, virtual happy hour Fri 4pm. Thanks again team. Let’s keep the momentum going! :muscle:
